main_text.p: Et tinnitum faciebat ficut augur, Genef.43.32. in Jonath. Ex forma Pohal קשש Colligere, Conquirere ftipulas, ut Hebr. Levitic. 24.12. & Numer. 9.8. in Targ. Hierofolym.

קשיש, קשיש Chald. & Syriac. Senex, Decrepitus, de provecta aetate, Hebr. ישיש. Deinde Syriac. quoque eft Senior, Presbyter, nomen officii. Item de minore aetate, Senior, Adultior, Major natu in comparatione, 1. Reg. 2.22.1. Sam. 12. 2. Sic Syriac. ad Romanos 9.12. Plural. קשישיא, קשישין ܣܝܝܐ[?] Senes, Seniores, Presbyteri. Foeminin. ܣܝܝܐ[?] Decrepita, Lucae 2.36. Plur. ܐܣܝܝܐ[?] Decrepitae, Anus, 1. ad Timoth. 5.2. ad Tit. 2.3. Hinc eft Latin. Cafcus, de quo M. Varro, Cafcum antiquitus appellabatur, quod nos Vetus vocamus.
קשישותא Chald. Senium, Senectus, Proverbior. 30.17. Syriac. Presbyterium, Episcopatus, 1. ad Timoth. 3.1.
קשר Chal. Jaculari, Ejaculari. Aphel אקשית Idem. Ithpahel vide fupra in קשש.
קשתא, קשר Chald. Arcus. Plural. קשתין קשתיא & foeminin. קשותא, קשון Genef. 21. 20. in Jonath. & קשתן Jefa.5.28. Ex forma Hebr. cum Aff. וקשתותיהון Et arcus ipforum, Jerem.51.46.
קשר Chald. Sagittarius, Arcitenens. Plural. קשתין קשתיא.
